checklist.text: Choose your business form and register it where it needs registering (company or limited liability partnership at the SECP; a written partnership deed for a partnership).
Give every employee written terms and check your duties as an employer.
Put important deals with customers and suppliers in writing, and keep a signed copy.
Check your tax registration and filing with the FBR (outside our law library).
Keep invoices, receipts and contracts together, for example in your Legal Vault.
Decide how disputes will be settled, and note the time limits for chasing unpaid money.
